labels: Synthetic site: located from GLAD canopy height, Hansen, WorldCover and Sentinel-2 imagery because no public planting polygon could be reached. It is not a documented project.
warnings: The control is matched on 2017, the store's first year (the year before the baseline 2018): it has few Sentinel-2 observations and sparse valid pixels in places (survey S16), so the control match rests on a weak year.

Only 43% of the ring's candidate pixels (137,101 of 317,171) have 2017 data, the year the control is matched on: a ring pixel without it cannot be filtered, so the control is drawn from that 43% alone and may gather where 2017 had clear views. Pass --match-year with a year of fuller data (2017 to 2018; the default is 2017).
105 of 6,200 site pixels were dropped: 105 lack data in some year from 2018 to 2025 (the panel rule) and 0 have another radar pattern than the site's majority (survey B5).
32 of 9,331 control pixels were dropped: 32 lack data in some year from 2018 to 2025 (the panel rule) and 0 have another radar pattern than the site's majority (survey B5).

Placebos hold a median of 924 pixels (at most 3099, a third of the control pool), fewer than the site's 6095. A smaller placebo has a larger sampling term in 1 - cos, so a change in per-pixel spread between years moves the band rather than only widening it; a year counts only when the site's change is above both the band and zero, so a falling divergence is never called diverging. Widen the ring or pass a larger control for placebos of the site's size.

labels: Synthetic site: located from GLAD canopy height, Hansen, WorldCover and Sentinel-2 imagery because no public planting polygon could be reached. It is not a documented project.
warnings: The control is matched on 2017, the store's first year (the year before the baseline 2018): it has few Sentinel-2 observations and sparse valid pixels in places (survey S16), so the control match rests on a weak year.

The site already differs from its control at the baseline 2018: its baseline divergence is above 100% of the placebos'; it moved +0.0470 further from the control between 2017 and 2018. Change that began before 2018 is left out of the divergence change, which then understates it; if the site was prepared, planted or began regrowing before 2018, pass an earlier --year-a (and --match-year).
